title: NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover Collects Samples
caption:
NASA’s Curiosity rover is busy on Mars. It has successfully drilled 49 times to collect rock samples, helping us understand the red planet's past composition.

Source: Nasa - NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover Collects Samples
